arxiv-2209-04547.title: Defend Data Poisoning Attacks on Voice Authentication
arxiv-2209-04547.creator: Ke Li, Cameron Baird, and Dan Lin
arxiv-2209-04547.description: Abstract With the advances in deep learning, speaker verification has achieved very high accuracy and is gaining popularity as a type of biometric authentication option in many scenes of our daily life, especially the growing market of web services. Compared to traditional passwords, “vocal passwords” are much more convenient as they relieve people from memorizing different passwords.

arxiv-2303-13548.title: Hey Dona! Can you help me with student course registration?
arxiv-2303-13548.creator: Vishesh Kalvakurthi, Aparna S. Varde, John Jenq
arxiv-2303-13548.description: Abstract In this paper. we present a demo of an intelligent personal agent Hey Dona or just Dona with virtual voice assistance in student course registration. It is a deployed project in the theme of AI for education. In this digital age with a myriad of smart devices, users often delegate tasks to agents.

arxiv-2401-00310.title: Iterative approximations of periodic trajectories for nonlinear systems with discontinuous inputs
arxiv-2401-00310.creator: Alexander Zuyev 1,2 , Peter Benner
arxiv-2401-00310.description: Abstract Nonlinear control-affine systems described by ordinary differential equations with bounded measurable input functions are considered. The solvability of general boundary value problems for these systems is formulated in the sense of Carathéodory solutions. It is shown that, under the dominant linearization assumption, the considered class of boundary value problems admits a unique solution for any admissible control.

arxiv-2408-13636.title: Gravity or turbulence? VI. The physics behind the Kennicutt-Schmidt relations
arxiv-2408-13636.creator: Javier Ballesteros-Paredes, Manuel Zamora-Avilés, Carlos Román-Zúñiga, Aina Palau, Bernardo Cervantes-Sodi, Karla Gutiérrez-Dávila, Vianey Camacho, Eric Jiménez-Andrade, and Adriana Gazol
arxiv-2408-13636.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Javier Ballesteros-Paredes, Manuel Zamora-Avilés, Carlos Román-Zúñiga, Aina Palau, Bernardo Cervantes-Sodi, Karla Gutiérrez-Dávila, Vianey Camacho, Eric Jiménez-Andrade, and Adriana Gazol. We explain the large variety of star formation laws in terms of one single, simple law that can be inferred from the definition of the star formation rate and basic algebra.

arxiv-2409-05263.title: How to survive the Squid Games using probability theory.
arxiv-2409-05263.creator: Elena Moltchanova, Miguel Moyers-González., Geertrui Van de Voorde
arxiv-2409-05263.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Elena Moltchanova, Miguel Moyers-González., Geertrui Van de Voorde. In this paper, we consider how probability theory can be used to determine the survival strategy in two of the “Squid Game” and “Squid Game: The Challenge” challenges: the Hopscotch and the Warships. We show how Hopscotch can be easily tackled with the knowledge of the binomial distribution, taught in introductory statistics courses, while Warships is a much more complex problem, which can be tackled at different levels.

arxiv-2506-17921.title: How Trees on Atoms of Subset Algebras Define Minimal Forests and Their Growth
arxiv-2506-17921.creator: V. A. Buslov
arxiv-2506-17921.description: Abstract A complete description is given of how minimal trees on atoms of the algebra of subsets 𝔄 k \mathfrak{A}_{k} generated by minimal spanning k k -component forests of a weighted digraph V V determine the form of these forests and how forests grow with increasing number of arcs (that is with a decrease in the number of trees).

arxiv-2510-22890.title: Reducing Measurements in Quantum Erasure Correction by Quantum Local Recovery
arxiv-2510-22890.creator: Ryutaroh Matsumoto
arxiv-2510-22890.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ryutaroh Matsumoto. As measurements are costly and prone to errors on certain quantum computing devices, we should reduce the number of measurements and the number of measured qudits as small as possible in quantum erasure correction. It is intuitively obvious that a decoder can omit measurements of stabilizers that are irrelevant to erased qudits, but this intuition has not been rigorously formalized as far as the author is aware.

arxiv-2511-08143.title: Relation as a Prior: A Novel Paradigm for LLM-based Document-level Relation Extraction
arxiv-2511-08143.creator: Qiankun Pi†, Yepeng Sun†, Jicang Lu, Qinlong Fan, Ningbo Huang, Shiyu Wang
arxiv-2511-08143.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qiankun Pi†, Yepeng Sun†, Jicang Lu, Qinlong Fan, Ningbo Huang, Shiyu Wang. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated their remarkable capabilities in document understanding. However, recent research reveals that LLMs still exhibit performance gaps in Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) as requiring fine-grained comprehension. The commonly adopted "extract entities then predict relations" paradigm in LLM-based methods leads to these gaps due to two main reasons: (1) Numerous unrelated entity pairs introduce noise and interfere with the relation prediction for truly related entity pairs.

arxiv-2512-21170.title: A Unified Framework for EEG Seizure Detection Using Universum-Integrated Generalized Eigenvalues Proximal Support Vector Machine
arxiv-2512-21170.creator: Yogesh Kumar, Vrushank Ahire, M. A. Ganaie
arxiv-2512-21170.description: Abstract The paper presents novel Universum-enhanced classifiers: the Universum Generalized Eigenvalue Proximal Support Vector Machine (U-GEPSVM) and the Improved U-GEPSVM (IU-GEPSVM) for EEG signal classification. Using the computational efficiency of generalized eigenvalue decomposition and the generalization benefits of Universum learning, the proposed models address critical challenges in EEG analysis: non-stationarity, low signal-to-noise ratio, and limited labeled data.

pmc-11511489.title: Design of Docking Interfaces for On-Orbit Assembly of Large Structures in Space
pmc-11511489.creator: Shuai Liu, Enyang Zhang, Zhenbang Xu, Jingxu Zhang
pmc-11511489.description: Considering the complexity of on-orbit assembly during space missions and the super-large size of space structures, this paper presents the design for a new type of docking interface with an androgynous body that exhibits a number of advantages, including high connection strength and a compact structure. The androgynous body has a conical guided symmetric design with a symmetry of 90°.

pmc-11515706.title: The effect of coaching on health information literacy in patients with chronic kidney disease: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11515706.creator: Yimin Hu, Bin Zhang, Zhihao Hu, Jingwen Huang, Ling Wang, Yuting Wei, Baojia Zheng, Qing Xue
pmc-11515706.description: BackgroundSince chronic kidney disease is highly insidious in the early stages, most diagnosed patients have already developed irreversible renal failure. There is a lack of effective implementation and standardization of health education management for patients with chronic kidney disease, and the impact of health education management on health information literacy is not yet known.

pmc-11612841.title: GABAergic signalling in the suprachiasmatic nucleus is required for coherent circadian rhythmicity
pmc-11612841.creator: Nathan Klett, Heinrich S Gompf, Charles N Allen, Olga Cravetchi, Lauren M Hablitz, Ali N Gunesch, Robert P Irwin, William D Todd, Clifford B Saper, Patrick M Fuller
pmc-11612841.description: The suprachiasmatic nucleus is the circadian pacemaker of the mammalian brain. Suprachiasmatic nucleus neurons display synchronization of their firing frequency on a circadian timescale, which is required for the pacemaker function of the suprachiasmatic nucleus. However, the mechanisms by which suprachiasmatic nucleus neurons remain synchronized in vivo are poorly understood, although synaptic communication is considered indispensable.

pmc-11646329.title: Impact of Sodium‐Glucose Co‐Transporter‐2 Inhibitors on Exercise‐Induced Pulmonary Hypertension
pmc-11646329.creator: Taijyu Satoh, Nobuhiro Yaoita, Satoshi Higuchi, Kotaro Nochioka, Saori Yamamoto, Haruka Sato, Shunsuke Tatebe, Kaito Yamada, Yusuke Yamada, Kohei Komaru, Naoki Chiba, Yuki Sarashina, Ryuichi Mori, Mitsuru Nakada, Hideka Hayashi, Hideaki Suzuki, Hiroyuki Takahama, Hideki Ota, Satoshi Yasuda
pmc-11646329.description: Patients with borderline pulmonary hypertension (PH) often experience shortness of breath or exacerbation of PH during exercise, known as exercise‐induced PH. However, the pathogenesis of exercise‐induced post‐capillary PH (post‐EIPH) and its treatment strategies remain unclear. Recent guidelines and consensus documents have highlighted the benefits of sodium‐glucose cotransporter‐2 (SGLT2) inhibitors in heart failure and chronic kidney disease (CKD).

pmc-11683252.title: Surface roughness and profile dataset of Ti6Al4V textured by laser ablation and spark erosion
pmc-11683252.creator: Victor Caso Moreira, Artur Fernando de Vito, Fabrizio Leonardi, Sergio Delijaicov, Rodrigo Magnabosco
pmc-11683252.description: The Ti6Al4V alloy is widely recognized for its extensive industrial applications, particularly in the aeronautics sector, due to its exceptional strength to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance. In this context, many industrial processes depend critically on surface area, topology, and roughness.

pmc-12379309.title: Tobacco use patterns and associated factors among youth in Kampala’s informal settlements: a cross-sectional study in Bwaise
pmc-12379309.creator: Nakitende Joyce, Anthony Kirabira, Adelaine Aryaija-Karemani, Nazarius Mbona Tumwesigye
pmc-12379309.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTobacco use remains a major global public health challenge, in Uganda it is notably higher among the youth, especially those in informal settlements. Despite periodic national surveys, recent data on this high-risk group is scarce.

pmc-12405343.title: Flexible ureteroscopy in renal anomalies: an explainable AI model for surgical outcome prediction from EAU endourology
pmc-12405343.creator: Carlotta Nedbal, Vineet Gauhar, Sairam Adithya, Nithesh Naik, Shilpa Gite, Het Sevalia, Daniele Castellani, Andrea Gregori, Frédéric Panthier, Yiloren Tanidir, Anil Shrestha, Vikram Sridharan, Abhishek Singh, Boyke Soebhali, Mohamed Amine Lakmichi, Saeed Biin Hamri, Bhaskar Kumar Somani
pmc-12405343.description: Aim and objectiveFlexible ureteroscopy (fURS) is a well-established modality for managing urolithiasis in patients with congenital renal anomalies such as horseshoe kidneys (HK), malrotated kidneys (MK), and pelvic ectopic kidneys (PEK). Still, these anatomical variants present unique challenges that complicate stone clearance and procedural planning.

pmc-12457164.title: Successful rescue of PD-1 inhibitor-induced TEN by vincristine combination therapy: a case report and literature review
pmc-12457164.creator: Hui-Yi Huang, Jia-Qi Liu, Yun-Yun Zeng, Zhi-Hao Huang, Shan Su
pmc-12457164.description: With the growing use of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in the management of various solid malignancies, immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are increasingly recognized. Toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), though rare, represents a severe and potentially fatal cutaneous irAE with a high mortality rate.

pmc-13172952.title: 246 Adapting a parenting program for Latina mothers impacted by intimate partner violence: Early insights
pmc-13172952.creator: Iris Cardenas, Lisa Berlin, Carmen Alvarez, Bushra Sabri
pmc-13172952.description: Objectives/Goals: Parenting programs overlook the needs of Latina mothers affected by intimate partner violence (IPV). To address this, we aim to adapt the Attachment and Biobehavioral Catch-up (ABC) parenting program. Objective: to understand core parenting challenges and strengths, identify implementation needs, and deliver a contextually responsive protocol.

pmc-13375656.title: Factors Supporting Translational, Participatory Ecology Projects—Observations from Ten Years of Collaborative Research on Invasive Fish
pmc-13375656.creator: Irene Adrian-Kalchhauser, Karen Bussmann-Charran, Anouk N’Guyen, Philipp Emanuel Hirsch, Joschka Wiegleb, Lukas Bergmann, Patricia Burkhardt-Holm
pmc-13375656.description: Translational participatory research for environmental management occupies a demanding space at the interface of societal needs and academic research. Projects in this space usually face the challenge of reconciling stakeholder involvement and real-world applicability with academic career requirements such as excellence in fundamental research and the attraction of substantial research funds.
